stills.name: green_plate
stills.prompt: Photograph of a green screen studio: a man in a plain grey t-shirt and dark jeans stands in front of a large chroma key green backdrop that curves into the floor. Soft studio lighting with a gentle falloff toward the corners, a few fabric wrinkles in the backdrop, a faint shadow at his feet, his full figure in view, natural skin, realistic photo, 35mm lens.

stills.name: blue_plate
stills.prompt: Photograph of a blue screen studio: a woman in a plain beige sweater and dark trousers sits on a simple wooden stool in front of a large chroma key blue backdrop that curves into the floor. Soft studio lighting, a few wrinkles in the blue fabric, a faint shadow under the stool, her full figure in view, realistic photo, 35mm lens.

stills.name: flat_green_plant
stills.prompt: A potted monstera plant in a plain white ceramic pot, standing alone in the centre, against a perfectly flat, uniform chroma key green background, evenly lit, no shadow on the background, product photo, sharp leaf edges.

stills.name: hair_green
stills.prompt: Portrait photograph of a woman with long, loose, curly hair with many fine flyaway strands, lit from behind by a rim light so single strands of hair glow, wearing a plain dark top, in front of an evenly lit chroma key green screen, head and shoulders, sharp focus on the hair edges, realistic photo.

stills.name: highlights_green
stills.prompt: Product photograph of a clear glass bottle of water and a polished chrome cup on a small grey table in front of a chroma key green screen. A hard spotlight from the side gives bright specular highlights and blown-out white reflections on the glass and the metal, and a bright lit rim along the edge of the bottle, realistic photo.
